summary: Richtech Robotics filed an 8-K on August 21, 2026, disclosing its board authorized a stock repurchase program of up to $12 million of Class B common stock, with a one-year term ending August 21, 2027. The program will be executed via a Rule 10b5-1 trading plan, subject to market conditions, and may be modified or terminated at any time. The company also approved a healthcare cash stipend of $750 per bi-weekly paycheck for its CEO, CFO, and COO, an aggregate of about $19,500 annually. No shares were specified. Watch for execution pace and potential price support.
